Lighting matches reference 4: cool white downlight from overhead troughs, soft pale blue fill, deep soft shadow, no warm, amber or green light, with pale blue light from the viewer's left on her face and forearms. Same matte-painted brushwork and palette as reference 4.

True transparent background, including negative spaces between limbs and body; no ground, floor, cast shadow slab, furniture, table, hologram, border, text or other people.
